summary: SprintGrid is an e‑commerce infrastructure provider building real‑time personalization and support chat widgets. They need sub-100ms p99 for 1–2k concurrent users on peak funnels, are very cost sensitive, and want recommendations on batching, prefix/KV caching and int8 quantization to reduce per‑token cost. Evaluating Redwood Dedicated + Optimize; Private/VPC optional if residency and KMS integration verified.
notes: Sales notes - shorthand: customer goal = aggressive tail latency + low u / cost. Primary KPI: p99 < 100ms for chat (avg token length ~12). Throughput target: 150–250 RPS during peak campaign windows.
Tech quote (CTO): "We will accept slightly lower top‑end quality if 2x cost savings + stable 99th percentile. Need transparent perf numbers not marketing."
POC constraints: cannot send PII outside VPC. Need KMS integration + audit logs. Retention for audit logs 1 year minimum.
Benchmarks so far: hosted baseline p50 18ms p95 62ms p99 180ms (small model). Hypothesis: continuous batching + KV cache + int8 quantization could hit p99 < 100ms and cut token cost ~40%.
Ask from SE: provide suggested batching window and pad strategy for 95th percentile latency; recommend quantization profile and fallback model variant mapping for graceful degradation.
Procurement note: finance wants committed monthly pricing for Dedicated; legal asked for SOC2 addendum. Timeline optimistic for Mar close if POC validates economics.
